answer: Height of the existing dining half walls is NOT printed. A-050 KN8 only says 'DEMO HALF WALLS IN DINING ROOM. RE: FURNITURE SHEETS FOR NEW LAYOUT.' F-sheets show only the new layout; no existing elevation, section or demo note gives a height.
why_not_printed: The set has no existing interior elevations. A-62x and A-401 show only new conditions and do not cut the half walls. F-201..F-702 show new furniture. E-200, M-200 and VC-02 show the walls in plan only. There is no specification section 02 41 19 (A-902 refers only to C02200 Demolition, see Civil). Keep the RFI. The loaded 3'-6" is an assumption.

answer: The existing gypsum board is removed and the new 1/2" cement board is fastened directly to the studs. The cement board does NOT go over the existing board. Detail A2/A-604 'TILE TO GYP TRANSITION AT RESTROOM' shows one layer in one plane: CEMENT BOARD below the 'CEMENT/GYP. TRANSITION' line and GYPSUM BOARD above it, with the transition 2 1/4" (+/-) below T/TILE AT RR. A-202 note G.2 says 'BETWEEN WALL TILE AND STUDS: 1/2" CEMENTITIOUS BACKER BOARD'. A-050 KN10 at the Men's and Women's restrooms says 'REMOVE EXISTING WALL FINISHES AND PREPARE FOR NEW'. A-611 note 3 says 'CEMENTITIOUS BOARD TO STOP - RE: DETAIL'. A-601..A-603 and A-621/A-622 note A.5 say 'PROVIDE CEMENTITIOUS BOARD SUBSTRATE FOR THE FULL HEIGHT OF TILE AT ALL WALLS WITH WALL TILE'.
scope_note: The loaded 617.08 SF of existing board demolition stands. Above the tile (T/TILE 6'-8 1/2" per A-611) the gypsum board is in the same plane as the cement board (A2/A-604). Whether the existing board above the tile stays or is replaced is not stated beyond KN10.

answer: Four (4) new 6" diameter beverage conduits. P-211 labels them 'NEW 6" BEVERAGE CONDUIT ABOVE CEILING' and '6" DIAMETER BEVERAGE CONDUITS ABOVE CEILING'. They leave the beverage rack and carbonator on the service side of the kitchen/service wall: one passes through the wall and three pass above the door head. They run to four drink towers and drop as 4" Sch 40 PVC in the walls at the towers. K-611 confirms '6" PVC SLEEVE PENETRATIONS'. The size of the draftstop patch around each chase is NOT printed.
operation: Count of the 6" conduits drawn on P-211 crossing the kitchen/service wall line = 4 (shown with the 4 elbows at the rack). Size = 6" dia as labelled on P-211. Patch size is not printed.
why_not_printed: Only the patch dimension is not printed. A-221 does not graphically locate the draftstop line at this wall (the heavy dashed line in the legend was not found in the plan vectors), and no sheet gives a patch size. The current load is 2 chases at 2'-0" x 2'-0". Per P-211 the count should be 4 chases at 6" dia conduits. The patch area per chase is still an RFI.
